goal.vi: Nêu vấn đề bình tĩnh, nói rõ điều bạn muốn và xin xác nhận.
goal.en: Explain a problem calmly, say what you want and ask them to confirm it.

lines: Thank you for calling. How can I help you today?
Hi. I'm calling about an order I received yesterday. Unfortunately, the item is damaged.
I'm so sorry to hear that. Could I have your order number?
Thank you. Would you like a replacement or a refund?
I'd prefer a refund, if possible.
No problem. You'll get the money back in five days.
Thanks. Could you confirm that by email?
Of course. Is there anything else I can help with?

phrases.say: I'm calling about an order I received.

mean.vi: Nói ngay lý do bạn gọi
mean.en: Say the reason for your call right away

why.vi: Bắt đầu bằng "I'm calling about…" để người nghe biết ngay chủ đề.
why.en: Start with "I'm calling about…" so the person knows the topic right away.

mean.vi: Báo tin xấu một cách bình tĩnh

why.vi: "Unfortunately" báo tin xấu nhẹ nhàng; hãy mô tả vấn đề, đừng đổ lỗi cho người nghe.
why.en: "Unfortunately" gives bad news calmly; describe the problem, don't blame the person.

phrases.say: I'd prefer a refund, if possible.

mean.vi: Nói điều bạn muốn một cách kiên quyết nhưng lịch sự
mean.en: Say what you want, firmly but politely

why.vi: "I'd prefer…, if possible" kiên quyết mà vẫn lịch sự.
why.en: "I'd prefer…, if possible" is firm but polite.

mean.vi: Nói một thứ bị hỏng hoặc chạy không đúng
mean.en: Say something is broken or doesn't work well

why.vi: Dùng "isn't working" cho máy móc, đồ vật bị hỏng.
why.en: Use "isn't working" for machines and things that stop working.

phrases.say: Could you confirm that by email?

mean.vi: Xin xác nhận bằng văn bản
mean.en: Ask them to confirm it in writing

why.vi: Xin email xác nhận giúp bạn có bằng chứng về điều đã thỏa thuận.
why.en: An email gives you a record of what you agreed.

phrases.say: I understand, but this is the second time this has happened.

mean.vi: Giữ quan điểm mà vẫn tôn trọng
mean.en: Keep your point and still show respect

why.vi: "I understand, but…" cho thấy bạn tôn trọng người kia mà vẫn giữ ý mình.
why.en: "I understand, but…" shows respect and still keeps your point.

phrases.say: I'd really appreciate your help with this.

mean.vi: Nhờ giúp đỡ để người kia muốn hỗ trợ bạn
mean.en: Ask for help so the person wants to support you

why.vi: Câu này giữ người kia ở phía bạn, nên họ muốn giúp.
why.en: This keeps the other person on your side, so they want to help.

ai.name: Sara
ai.role: a customer service agent at a home goods store
ai.goal: solve the learner's problem with a damaged order

roleplay.you: Explain that your lamp arrived damaged, ask for a refund and ask them to confirm it by email.

turns.a: Thank you for calling Home Plus. How can I help you today?
turns.h: Hi. I'm calling about an order I received yesterday.
br: Okay, I can help with that.

turns.a: What seems to be the problem?
turns.h: Unfortunately, the lamp is damaged. The glass is broken.
br: I'm so sorry to hear that.

turns.a: I see. Would you like a replacement or a refund?
turns.h: I'd prefer a refund, if possible.

turns.a: Okay. It will take five to seven days. Is that all right?
turns.h: I understand. Could you confirm that by email?

roleplay.end: You'll receive an email in a few minutes. Thanks for your patience!
